segments.title: Google Wallet is on iPhone now
segments.say: Google Wallet just landed on iPhone. But it can't tap to pay at the store.

segments.title: What it CAN hold
segments.say: It holds boarding passes, tickets, loyalty cards and gym memberships. You scan cards with the camera.

segments.title: Tracks your orders
segments.say: It also shows recent purchases and delivery updates from your Google account.

segments.title: No tap to pay on iPhone
segments.say: Paying at the register still isn't there. Google points to platform restrictions.

segments.title: US only for now
segments.say: It's US only for now. Not tested by us.
Follow for Phone Trick number 17 tomorrow.
